requirement: A fresh seat (signed in, no account record or site yet) loads /new/ and Help's restore answers an empty conversation, not 401

oracle.ref: PR #1085 (fix); fix evidence: 09/10/2026 on the private stand tracy-srd and on dsh-passwords 2.7.7-tracy.5: every /new/ load by a fresh seat logged a 401 on /api/assistant/conversation. Cause: signedIn() in assistant/route.js answered NOT_SIGNED_IN when the signed session's email had no account row.
oracle.invariant: S2 answers HTTP 200 with conversationId null and turns []. The page calls /api/assistant/conversation at least once and every call answers below 400 (before the fix: 401 NOT_SIGNED_IN on every load).
